headline.text: L1 S4 scrapped *900 lbs* of heavy cream after chiller left off overnight — temp reached 76°F, product showed spoilage.

summary: One food-safety event — 900 lbs of heavy cream scrapped at L1 S4 after warming to 76°F overnight when chiller was not reconnected. Two sanitation gaps flagged at L3 and L2. Three product holds across plants, two resolved within window.

holds.title: Pistachio halves quarantine hold released
holds.summary: LPN R342719 (10221 Pistachio Halves, lot RTE00138) cleared micro and released for production after quarantine review.
holds.status: Resolved — Kathleen Gilbert cleared for use at 16:15:58.

holds.title: 3 pallets Truffle Line chocolate on hold pending labels
holds.summary: End-of-3rd-shift product held because Quality did not request status-change authorization; final labels could not be completed.
holds.status: Open at window close — awaiting QA disposition and label completion.

food_safety.title: Heavy cream spoiled on S4 after chiller left off
food_safety.summary: 60% of milk tank (900 lbs heavy cream, item 20009) found at 76°F with spoiled odor and acidic taste; chiller was not reconnected after prior shift, product warmed overnight.
food_safety.status: Resolved — product scrapped, tank and lines cleaned and sanitized by 09:12:34.

sanitation.title: FFS conveyor belt dragging on floor
sanitation.summary: Belt after bagging station sagging low enough to contact floor; QA requested maintenance adjust height before continuing production.
sanitation.status: Resolved — maintenance adjusted belt by 22:44:10, line resumed.

sanitation.title: Truffle Line rollers missed during Level 2 clean
sanitation.summary: Multiple rollers between depositor and packaging found unclean after Level 2 clean completed; line paused to clean before startup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — rollers cleaned before line restarted.

opportunities.text: Consider adding chiller-reconnection step to S4 kitchen end-of-shift checklist — today's 900-lb cream loss echoes risk when dairy remains in unrefrigerated tanks overnight.
Add belt-clearance verification to FFS post-setup QA sign-off — belt dragged on floor after conveyor adjustment today.
Review Truffle Line Level 2 clean checklist to explicitly include roller inspection between depositor and pack — multiple rollers were missed today.
